 CORAM:HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE DEVAN M. DESAI  Date : 03/04/2024  ORAL ORDER Heard learned advocate for the applicant/s. 
2. The present application is filed for the restoration of the main matter which was dismissed for default on account of non removal of office objections. 
3. Perused the application and considered the submissions made by learned advocate for the applicant/s. Learned advocate for the applicant/s has made a statement at bar that he/she will remove office objections within a period of two weeks from today.
